cardOverview.overviewText: A co-branded Patanjali Swarn card rewarding purchases at Patanjali outlets, with milestone benefits and lifestyle perks.

items.child: 1+1 offer on movie tickets at Bookmyshow.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: 1+1 offer on movie tickets at Bookmyshow.
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy 1+1 offer (up to INR 200) on movie tickets at Bookmyshow on weekends/once per month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Patanjali
benefitRows.offer: Get 10% cashback at Patanjali online and offline stores, on transactions of INR 500 or more. Earn monthly cashback of up to INR 750.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, shop at Patanjali online or offline stores with transactions of ₹500 or more using your RBL Patanjali Swarn credit card. Earn up to ₹750 cashback monthly. Contact RBL customer care at 1860 123 4455 for help.
